why: A package function called without parentheses is still a call, at one level of package or two: `a = pkg.top;` calls pkg.top and `b = pkg.sub.low;` calls pkg.sub.low (MATLAB doc 'Namespaces' and 'Calling Functions': a function can be called with no parentheses when it takes no input; project rule: a real call into the project is never hidden).
